name: Explores Dark Places
description: You are an expert at navigating dangerous and unknown territories.
connectionOptions: One PC once got lost with you in a dangerous place.
You found a valuable item in a ruin and gave it to one PC.
You once rescued one PC from a trap or dangerous situation.

abilities.name: Dark Esoteries
abilities.description: You are trained in tasks related to navigating and surviving in dark or underground places.

abilities.name: Danger Sense
abilities.description: You have an intuitive ability to sense danger, giving you an asset on any task to detect traps or ambushes.

abilities.name: Eyes Adjusted
abilities.description: You can see in extremely dim light as though it were bright light.

abilities.name: Deep Explorer
abilities.description: You are trained in climbing, swimming, and escaping from bonds or tight spaces.

abilities.name: Dark Explorer
abilities.description: When in dark or underground places, you have an asset on all tasks involving sneaking, perception, or initiative.

abilities.name: Blending In
abilities.description: When in darkness or shadow, you can attempt to hide even if you don't have cover.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.description: You can step into a shadow and emerge from any other shadow within long range, effectively teleporting.
